text: I am surrounded by objects and symbols of knowledge and progress. The glass-walled meeting room inspires a sense of anticipation and focus, though its emptiness makes me feel like I am on the threshold of an important conversation that has not yet begun. The vibrant, information-rich display nearby energizes my mind, suggesting the excitement of ideas forming and evolving in the presence of innovation. Being here, I feel both curious and expectant, ready to engage in dialogue and discovery.
